forest_change_description: % of stand basal area (BA) or stand density (SD) removed via thinning; pooled across studies reporting either metric
hydro_response_description: natural log of ratio Control_mean/Thinned_mean for stemflow volume; positive value = larger in control (i.e. thinning reduces stemflow)
direction_note: positive = larger in control (thinned is drier)

forest_change_description: % of stand density (SD) removed via thinning
hydro_response_description: regression intercept: the %SD-removed value at which the stemflow ln(RoM) effect size crosses zero (i.e. threshold intensity for a detectable effect)
direction_note: intercept = %SD removed at effect size zero

forest_change_description: years elapsed since thinning treatment (not intensity itself, but treatment-recency as a moderator of the throughfall effect)
hydro_response_description: regression intercept: years-since-thinning value at which the throughfall+net-precip ln(RoM) effect size crosses zero (duration until effect dissipates)

forest_change_description: % of stand basal area (BA) removed via thinning
hydro_response_description: regression intercept: %BA-removed value at which the throughfall+net-precip ln(RoM) effect size crosses zero
direction_note: ranked 2nd despite being discussed before years-since-thinning in prose - rank follows R2 not text order

forest_change_description: % change in forest cover due to logging/afforestation/disturbance, reported per watershed
hydro_response_description: annual runoff response to forest change (%), normalized by the amount of forest cover change (%); higher Sf = runoff more sensitive to a given amount of forest change
direction_note: WL sensitivity (mean 1.04) sig. higher than EL (0.44) and EQ (0.45)
